item.title: Shrek 5 Might Be the Disney Fairy Tale It Swore to Destroy
item.description: Though DreamWorks treated it like a green-skinned black sheep throughout its decade-long development — so much so that animators considered working on it a punishment — the Shrek franchise quickly became beloved by families everywhere when the first movie debuted in 2001.

item.title: Scarlett Johansson’s Most Unsettling Sci-Fi Movie Is Officially Getting Cut From Netflix
item.description: Scarlett Johansson has spent years playing some of sci-fi ’s most recognizable women. Luc Besson transformed her into something approaching a god in 2014’s Lucy , and the much-maligned live-action Ghost in the Shell gave her a fully cybernetically enhanced body to play around with in a near-future Newport City. Of course, there’s also Black Widow, the former assassin who became one of the Marvel Cinematic Universe ’s most dependable heroes across nine films, from Iron Man 2 to Black Widow . Johansson has built a career playing characters who straddle the line between human and something otherworldly, but you’ve never seen ScarJo quite like this.

item.title: The best Han 86 build in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The best Han 86 build in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is likely to be something most players search for at one point or another, because it's the very first assault rifle you unlock in multiplayer. Not only that, but since the gun can be found on practically every single basic soldier in DMZ, it's incredibly easy to level it up and acquire most of the attachments.

item.title: The Case Against Larian Saving Dragon Age, No Matter How Tempting It Sounds
item.description: The possible takeover is hardly a new idea. Fans have been asking Larian to move into Thedas — Dragon Age’s world, a continent of grudging nations and grim cathedrals and a god nobody can quite prove is real — since Baldur’s Gate 3 came out in 2023 and completely rewrote the rules of fantasy RPG storytelling. For the last three years, posts have regularly surfaced on various BG3 or Dragon Age subreddits asking for this precise handover to unfold.

item.title: BG3 Owes Everything to One Underrated 2009 BioWare RPG
item.description: It’s late. The fire is burning low. The sardonic elven rogue who joined your party a few days ago pulls up a log, flashes a grin, and tells you (cheerfully) about his former employer, who would love to see him dead. The elf flirts with you like it’s a survival skill. Which, given said former employer, it might be. How nicely you take his jokes decides how much of the person underneath he lets you see, and whether he ever stops treating charm like armor.

item.title: Backrooms Director Teases Next Dream Projects — Is Portal One of Them?
item.description: Since the buzzy horror film Backrooms propelled Kane Parsons to instant fame, many are eager to know what the young director is working on next. Beyond a confirmed Backrooms sequel , many are convinced he will bring another world of corporate drudgery to the screen: it seems quite possible he'll helm a Portal movie. The young director has made it very clear that he’s a fan of Valve, previously citing the Portal games as a major inspiration for Backrooms and its sterile aesthetic.

item.title: Resident Evil Lead Teases Series’ ‘Conclusion’ Coming In the Next 10 Years
item.description: Resident Evil is celebrating its 30th anniversary this year. Capcom's iconic horror series has been a foundational part of the survival horro genre, and it's still delivering amazing entries, such as this year's Resident Evil Requiem . Still, that doesn't mean it will be around forever. With remakes of past titles catching up to new mainline games, the series may be entering a new phase, which may bring about its conclusion.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4’s Multiplayer Is the Best Call of Duty Has Been in 7 Years
item.description: After two years of back-to-back Black Ops games, Modern Warfare 4 was always going to feel like a breath of fresh air. Even though the differences between the two series are subtle, the minor tweaks to movement, gunplay, and aesthetic are always noticeable to anyone who plays year in, year out. And I've always been a Modern Warfare kid at heart, from way back in 2007, when I lived and breathed Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare for a year straight. The last Call of Duty that truly captivated me was 2019's Modern Warfare .

item.title: How to get Tifa and Barret's outfits in FFXIV
item.description: Tifa and Barret's outfits are the real stars in Final Fantasy 14 ' s event in the Keybound Brawlers , a new collaboration with Final Fantasy 7 . Unlike Cloud's outfit, which is based on the Final Fantasy 7: Advent Children design and has been in the game for ages, these two are based on the FF7 remake project. To get them and many other FF7 -themed cosmetics and items, you must survive the typing brawls and earn a special currency.

item.title: Major 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' Game Finally Lives Up To The Hype
item.description: With its fantastic animation and incredible attention to detail, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game felt like it was destined for greatness. And perhaps the fighting game could have gone down as the best Avatar interactive experience ever made had it not been released in July 2026 without some key components promised in its marketing. But now, three months later, Avatar Legends looks like it might to live up to its original promise.
